description: Defines a Note class representing a note in a note-taking app, with properties like id, title, content, createdAt, and updatedAt, along with serialization/deserialization methods and date formatting.

classes.name: Note
classes.description: A model class for notes, including properties for id, title, content, creation and update timestamps, with methods for JSON serialization/deserialization and formatted date string.

methods.name: Note.fromJson
methods.description: Factory constructor to create a Note instance from a JSON map.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Converts a Note instance into a JSON map for serialization.

methods.name: updatedAtFormatted
methods.description: Returns the updatedAt date formatted as a localized string.

methods.name: fromJsonList
methods.description: Static method to convert a list of JSON maps into a list of Note instances.
